Shabnim Ismail Becomes Leading T20 World Cup Wicket-Taker

South Africa's Shabnim Ismail has become the leading wicket-taker in the history of the T20 World Cup. She achieved this milestone during the ongoing tournament. This achievement places her ahead of other prominent bowlers in the T20 international cricket circuit.
